task: Complete existing Control Plane semantic execution and proof semantics capabilities with adversarial closure.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: The existing Control Plane can structurally validate plans and exact-head PASS evidence but can miss semantic code consumers, omitted required edits, durable Product Owner instructions, and claim/evidence scope mismatches, allowing material false positives.
observableOutcomes: Atlas emits symbol-aware semantic relationships and a task-specific execution route with explicit MUST_EDIT, MAY_EDIT, IMPACTED_READ_ONLY, AUTHORITY, OVERRIDE_OR_LEGACY, PROOF and UNKNOWN classifications.
Implementation Sync proves both actual changes are inside the approved envelope and every semantic MUST_EDIT requirement is represented in the verified change set.
Plan validation blocks vacuous critical plans, Truth blocks unsupported overclaims, and confidence cannot become PROVEN from free-form evidence presence.
Authority dependencies are reconciled against actual code imports and durable Product Owner instructions become machine-readable authority.
Verified completion transitions the development lifecycle through CLOSE and LEARN without leaving a stale ready-for-implementation plan.
unresolvedRisks: TypeScript dynamic access, runtime-generated keys and framework indirection cannot always be resolved statically and must remain explicit UNKNOWN rather than be guessed.
Historical evidence-ledger entries use the v1 shape and require conservative compatibility semantics instead of retroactively claiming proof breadth they never recorded.
Repository branch protection is hosting configuration and may remain an external requirement if the GitHub integration cannot administer protection.

in: existing Atlas semantic graph and execution-route projection
PO instruction authority and semantic Reference/Implementation Sync
Control Plane lifecycle close/learn and failure-intake reconcile cadence
out: automatic Known Failure promotion without human review
formal proof of complete JavaScript runtime behavior

assuranceCeiling.rationale: These changes govern whether development is allowed to start and whether completion may be reported. False negatives can omit required edits and false positives can certify unsupported claims, so type-aware dependency analysis, fail-closed UNKNOWN states, adversarial claim/evidence scope tests, lifecycle state tests, exact-head provenance and regression replay are required. Whole-program formal verification is not proportionate because dynamic runtime relationships remain explicitly UNKNOWN and are blocked rather than guessed.

acceptanceCriteria: A semantic consumer with no direct import edge is discovered through typed or contract identity and appears in impact/execution routing.
Actual production imports either resolve inside declared domain dependency closure or are classified as illegal, missing-edge, or ambiguous; silent drift is impossible.
A durable PO instruction can define positive and forbidden route/component/contract states and is evaluated by development planning and edit-time checks.

Reference Sync preserves export-rename detection and adds semantic component/config/registry/route/schema/token/display-contract relationships with lexical fallback only when semantic identity is unavailable.
Implementation Sync blocks both unplanned edits and omitted MUST_EDIT targets.
Critical PROVE_PLAN rejects placeholder, tautological, self-justifying or evidence-less content.
Truth evaluation distinguishes VERIFIED, PARTIAL, MISSING, STALE, FAILED, OVERCLAIM and UNKNOWN and never maps OVERCLAIM to DONE.
Confidence derives from structured proof strength, freshness, adversarial coverage and limitations rather than a non-empty evidence field.
TRUTH_GATE completion has an explicit CLOSE then LEARN lifecycle transition and stale completed plans no longer remain implementation-ready.
Failure-intake duplicate reconciliation runs at development-relevant cadence without auto-promoting unproven Known Failures.
invariants: UNKNOWN semantic relationships fail closed for serious development and are never silently downgraded to no-impact.
Actual code dependency and declared authority graph may not contradict each other without an explicit classified discrepancy.
A PASS-producing gate does not prove claims broader than the evidence scope it records.
Evidence presence alone contributes no confidence.
Truth Gate remains the completion evaluator; semantic proof logic strengthens it rather than creating a competing gate.
Atlas remains the system self-knowledge authority; semantic graph logic extends the same runtime.
Resumable Verification evidence reuse semantics remain exact-head/equivalence-bound and are not weakened.

alternatives.summary: Add isolated new semantic and truth gates beside the current Control Plane.
alternatives.reason: It would create parallel authorities and repeat the fragmentation the Product Owner explicitly wants removed.

alternatives.summary: Extend the existing Atlas, development guards, evidence model, confidence evaluator and Truth Gate with one shared semantic model.
alternatives.reason: It preserves existing authorities while moving missing understanding earlier into planning, editing and completion.

alternatives.summary: Keep lexical/file-level analysis and add more defect-specific regression tests only.
alternatives.reason: It catches known examples but does not repair the capability failure that allowed unknown semantic consumers and unsupported claims.

specialistReviews.finding: Semantic understanding must extend Atlas and Authority Graph rather than create a second graph authority.
specialistReviews.resolution: Use a shared typed semantic graph emitted by the existing Atlas runtime and consumed by planning, Reference Sync and Implementation Sync.

specialistReviews.finding: A single foundational diff could exceed the existing Release Risk Budget when mixed with Template Factory and storefront route changes.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep foundational Control Plane, Template Factory and storefront route corrections as separate release transactions while preserving one program and shared adversarial suite.
evidence: verified stress baseline: stale exact-head and risk-budget blocking

specialistReviews.finding: Claim and evidence records require stable identity, exact-head freshness and explicit proof boundaries.
specialistReviews.resolution: Add structured evidence semantics and compare proven scope against claim scope; legacy evidence remains conservative rather than implicitly upgraded.
evidence: verified stress baseline: Truth overclaim false positive
verified stress baseline: free-form confidence evidence false positive

specialistReviews.finding: Newly discovered semantic edges and missed failure classes must become durable prevention without auto-promoting uncertain failures.
specialistReviews.resolution: Persist missing-edge learning metadata and shorten reconciliation latency while retaining human-governed Known Failure promotion.

specialistReviews.finding: Lifecycle state must not strand a merged task as implementation-ready.
specialistReviews.resolution: Model TRUTH_GATE to CLOSE to LEARN explicitly and test idempotent closure against exact task/head identity.

challenge.scenario: Two files share a semantic contract key but have no direct import relationship.
challenge.finding: Import-only reverse traversal misses the consumer.
challenge.resolution: Index semantic identities and traverse contract/symbol edges in impact routing.

challenge.scenario: A component key is renamed in its registry while stale Page Schema consumers remain.
challenge.finding: Path-envelope Implementation Sync can pass despite an omitted required edit.
challenge.resolution: Derive MUST_EDIT consumers from semantic graph and require them inside the verified change set.

challenge.scenario: A critical plan replaces meaningful prose with x/TODO while preserving all required fields.
challenge.finding: Structural completeness can masquerade as engineering quality.
challenge.resolution: Apply semantic-text quality heuristics plus cross-field obligations and evidence-producer requirements.

challenge.scenario: A repository-wide Atlas completeness claim cites generic Quality Tests PASS.
challenge.finding: Fresh PASS evidence can still be semantically too narrow.
challenge.resolution: Compare CLAIM_SCOPE against EVIDENCE_SCOPE/PROVEN_SCOPE and return OVERCLAIM.

challenge.scenario: Capability registry evidence is replaced by arbitrary free-form text.
challenge.finding: Presence-based scoring can still reach PROVEN.
challenge.resolution: Only structured verified evidence with matching subject/capability scope contributes semantic proof points.

challenge.scenario: Admin imports storefront, builder, content and integration authorities not declared in DOMAIN-ADMIN closure.
challenge.finding: Actual code and authority graph disagree.
challenge.resolution: Classify each actual edge; record legitimate orchestration dependencies and block prohibited or ambiguous edges.

challenge.scenario: A Product Owner decision exists only in conversation history.
challenge.finding: Future planning cannot deterministically enforce it.
challenge.resolution: Create versioned machine-readable PO instruction authority with positive/forbidden states, scope, lifecycle and evidence.

challenge.scenario: TypeChecker cannot resolve a runtime-computed registry key.
challenge.finding: A guessed relationship would create false confidence.
challenge.resolution: Emit UNKNOWN with reason/confidence and block serious execution until explicitly resolved or covered by a fallback proof.

challenge.scenario: Truth completes a task that is then merged but active-plan remains implementation-ready.
challenge.finding: Later branches inherit stale intent and can be blocked incorrectly.
challenge.resolution: Make CLOSE/LEARN an idempotent explicit lifecycle transition bound to completion evidence and merge/head identity.

challenge.scenario: Multiple unresolved failure-intake issues are duplicates within the same workday.
challenge.finding: Weekly reconciliation keeps noisy duplicate backlog alive too long.
challenge.resolution: Run deterministic reconciliation in normal CI/knowledge cadence while leaving promotion decisions human-governed.

challenge.scenario: Typed .d.mts declarations for existing shoperation quality runtimes are classified as an unrelated fallback subsystem.
challenge.finding: Release Risk adds unclassified-change medium risk even though the declarations carry no independent runtime behavior and belong to the same quality-infrastructure authority as their .mjs modules.
challenge.resolution: Classify scripts/lib/shoperation-*.d.mts and scripts/shoperation-*.d.mts under quality-infrastructure without changing maxPoints, maxSubsystems or any risk weight.

proofPlan: Replay Atlas semantic-consumer and Authority Graph reality adversarial cases against the same failure conditions.
Replay export rename and component-key/display-contract stale-consumer cases with semantic graph first and lexical fallback second.
Inject x/TODO/tautological critical-plan content and require Plan Before Code BLOCK.
Inject broad Atlas claim with generic Quality Tests evidence and require Truth OVERCLAIM/BLOCK.
Replace CAP-ATLAS evidence with free-form text and prove confidence cannot remain PROVEN.
Validate PO instruction registry schema and enforce shipping/payment separation instruction before storefront implementation transaction.
Prove bidirectional Implementation Sync by omitting a derived MUST_EDIT consumer and requiring BLOCK.
Exercise lifecycle VERIFIED to CLOSE to LEARN plus idempotent rerun and stale-plan rejection.
Run existing Resumable Verification, Known Failure generalization, Deep Atlas and Sentinel regressions to prove no foundational regression.
Use exact-head CI and relevant gates; no completion claim is permitted from local/unit green alone.

requirements.requirement: Atlas provides symbol-aware semantic execution relationships and task-specific edit-point routing while unresolved dynamic relationships remain explicit UNKNOWN.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A semantic consumer may not disappear merely because it lacks a direct import edge.

requirements.requirement: Actual cross-domain code dependencies are reconciled with the declared Authority Graph as allowed, missing-edge, illegal or ambiguous.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: No actual production import may silently contradict declared authority closure.

requirements.requirement: Durable explicit Product Owner decisions are represented as versioned machine-readable instruction authority and participate in plan/edit validation.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: An applicable active PO instruction cannot be ignored because it exists only as prose or prior chat context.

requirements.requirement: Implementation Sync verifies both actual diff inside the approved envelope and semantic MUST_EDIT requirements inside the actual verified change set.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A planned file envelope cannot hide an omitted semantic required edit.

requirements.requirement: Critical plan validation rejects placeholder, tautological, self-justifying and evidence-less content rather than checking field presence alone.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A critical plan whose substantive fields are x or TODO cannot PASS.

requirements.requirement: Truth compares claim scope with structured evidence scope and blocks stale, missing, failed, unknown or overclaimed completion.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Generic Quality Tests PASS cannot prove repository-wide Atlas completeness.

requirements.requirement: Architecture confidence is based on structured behavioral proof, freshness, adversarial breadth and limitations rather than evidence-string presence.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: UNVERIFIED_FREEFORM_CLAIM cannot contribute semantic proof confidence.

requirements.requirement: A verified development lifecycle transitions through TRUTH_GATE to CLOSE to LEARN and does not leave a completed plan implementation-ready.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Merged or explicitly closed verified work cannot remain ready-for-implementation.

requirements.requirement: New missed semantic relationships and duplicate failure intake feed durable reviewable learning without automatic unproven Known Failure promotion.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Unverified intake cannot automatically become canonical Known Failure authority.

requirements.requirement: Resumable Verification, Known Failure generalization, Deep Atlas hard-drift and Sentinel PR-noise separation retain their proven behavior.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Semantic/proof hardening may not weaken previously proven fail-closed capabilities.

notes: Foundation transaction only. Template Factory golden/handoff and storefront shipping/payment implementation changes are deliberately split into subsequent release transactions to stay within the existing Release Risk Budget; no parallel Control Plane is introduced. Rebased atomically onto canonical main after #655 Reference Sync rename-export identity and #653 Builder/Admin authority-direction repair. Completion Truth evidence now uses only exact-head blocking producers actually emitted on every PR; scheduled observation signals remain regression-tested but are not misrepresented as per-PR proof. Critical specialist reviews now carry explicit source/evidence references; verdict text alone is not accepted by PROVE_PLAN. Exact-head TypeScript proof exposed missing declaration contracts for the Node ESM Control Plane runtimes consumed directly by adversarial TS tests; adjacent .d.mts public API contracts are added instead of suppressing compiler checks. Release Risk classification is extended for adjacent Control Plane .d.mts declaration contracts; budget thresholds and risk weights remain unchanged.
